lessons.keep: Keep named options visible from discovery through the final choice.
lessons.avoid: Avoid leaving the reason for the final selection implicit after highlighting a different option.
lessons.open: Supplier verification, ranking criteria, outreach, quote timing, actual negotiation, delivery and all audio remain unverified.
try: Show three Tin creative options with the same labels through comparison, revision and approval.
Add a short decision reason when the user selects an option other than the one just improved.
